title: HavenHomes
description: Create, manage, and teleport to homes through an intuitive GUI with countdowns, effects, and persistence.
body:
# HavenHomes

HavenHomes is a lightweight, GUI-based homes plugin for Paper servers that allows players to create, manage, teleport to, and delete homes through intuitive menus rather than relying on multiple commands.

## Features

### Home Management

* Create homes through a GUI
* Chat-based home naming
* Support for spaces in home names
* Configurable maximum home limit
* View all homes in a dedicated menu
* Delete homes with confirmation menus

### Teleportation System

* Configurable teleport countdown
* Move-to-cancel functionality
* Countdown title display
* Teleport sounds
* Portal particle effects

### Persistence

* Homes are automatically saved to `homes.yml`
* Data persists through server restarts
* Automatic loading on startup

## Commands

| Command  | Description               |
| -------- | ------------------------- |
| `/homes` | Opens the HavenHomes menu |

## Configuration

```yml
max-homes: 3
teleport-delay-seconds: 5
```

## Requirements

* Paper 1.21+
* Java 21+

## Planned Features

* Resource pack icons
* Permissions-based home limits
* Home renaming
* Home favourites
* Multi-page home menus
